title: Exclusive: Fantagraphics Previews Akane Torikai's Wandering Cat's Cage Manga
content:
Fantagraphics ' new Takumigraphics imprint for East Asian comics revealed a preview of the English version Akane Torikai 's Wandering Cat's Cage ( Mandarin Gypsy Cat no Rōjō ) manga on Wednesday. The manga was previously scheduled for a May 26 release but is now slated for October 27.

In Akane Torikai 's Wandering Cat's Cage , it is the near future. Only a few women are still able to menstruate, and even fewer men will be born to them. Reproduction is limited to medical intervention controlled from on high, and the structures and lives of the past hold no weight: they are only hinted at through the remaining scraps of a world that no longer exists. Life can be good, though, if you fall in line, and the women of The City live bright, happy, tightly controlled lives. But complete obedience isn't for everyone. For the women across the river, who live in a rundown shantytown, viewing the opulence of the city from afar each night, life is different. It is humble, and often dangerous, but it is free. It is here that Sanada, a young acupuncturist, lives with the mysterious Reiho, the only male she's ever met, and who sells himself to the rich women who sneak across the river for something they've never experienced …The two form a small “family,” taking in other young women ousted from the city. But a real, living, breathing male might be too precious to leave to the shabby streets. When Reiho is kidnapped at gunpoint and taken to the breeding program in the city, Sanada must join with the other outcasts to try and rescue him, and learn the difficult truths of love, self-actualization, society, community, safety, and the future itself.

Jocelyne Allen is translating the manga, while Sarah Linsley is doing the lettering. Takumigraphics' release is in partnership with MSX: Mangasplaining Extra.

Torikai launched the manga in Kadokawa 's Da Vinci magazine in June 2017, and ended it in September 2018. Kadokawa published two compiled book volumes for the manga in November 2018.

Torikai made her debut as a manga creator in 2004. Her works include Sensei no Shiroi Uso (Teacher's White Lie), Jigoku no Girlfriend (Girlfriend from Hell), and Romance Bōfūiki . Torikai ended her Saturn Return manga in October 2022. Kodansha USA Publishing released Torikai's Sensei's Pious Lie ( Sensei no Shiroi Uso ) manga. The manga ran from 2013-2017.

title: The Horror Anime That Took Netflix by Storm Announces Its Grand Finale
content:
In the anime horror world, there simply aren’t enough creepy stories to match the world-shattering action series and/or romantic comedies that populate the medium. When a horror anime series makes its way into the world, many fans take notice, especially if it wasn’t born from Junji Ito, as prolific as the manga artist is. One major example has been The Summer Hikaru Died , an ongoing manga series that was brought to life as a Netflix exclusive by Cypic. While the anime is planning a comeback with its upcoming second season, the manga is preparing to bid a fond farewell to readers sooner than you might hope.

The creator of Summer Hikaru Died , Mokumokuren, has confirmed that there are only two more chapters left in the tank for the popular horror manga before it ends. The 51st chapter will arrive on October 20th, meaning there are only a few installments left before the horror series takes a bow. Without diving into spoiler territory, the players and elements of the series have aligned in recent chapters to give readers a worthy ending for this creepy story. Throughout the manga, Yoshiki has been struggling with both the supernatural elements invading his life and his own loneliness, making for an interesting dynamic across the board.

Why The Summer Hikaru Died is a Must-Watch

The Summer Hikaru Died is a story unlike any other , focusing on Yoshiki Tsujinaka, who immediately reveals that he knows his best friend isn’t all that he appears to be. Telling Hikaru that he knows he isn’t his best friend, but rather a being who is taking the form of the deceased character, the series starts by slowly injecting horror into every aspect of the sleepy mountain town. “Hikaru” himself is scary enough, harboring a terrifying form beneath his human exterior, but there are far more creatures bubbling beneath the surface. Ever since the manga debuted in 2021, The Summer Hikaru Died has made a name for itself with riveting storytelling and some of the scariest moments in anime history, which proved beneficial for the anime adaptation.

Netflix acting as the exclusive platform for The Summer Hikaru Died makes sense, considering how the platform has been aiming for anime supremacy in recent years. The anime adaptation has been brought to life by CyGames Pictures, or Cypic, which, ironically enough, is very fresh to the anime game. Opening in 2016, the production house has worked on franchises such as Umamusume : Pretty Derby and Apocalypse Hotel . With next year seeing the studio taking a crack at the now-legendary shonen series, Kagurabachi , Cypic might be the next big studio to keep an eye on as work continues on Hikaru’s upcoming second season.

title: Pokémon Anime and Pokémon GO Collaboration Episode and In-Game Event Announced
content:
Pokémon Horizons: The Series anime and Pokémon GO are teaming up for a new collaboration covering both the TV series and the mobile game. A special anime episode will air in Japan on September 18, while an accompanying Pokémon GO event will run worldwide from September 16 to 22.

Episode 150, titled “Hirogaru Sekai, Kimi to GO!” (The Expanding World, With You and GO!), will show Liko and her companions head out on fieldwork alongside Professor Willow from Pokémon GO . As their investigation progresses, the episode will reveal how Friede first met Charizard. PokéStops will also appear in the episode. A trailer was revealed.

Charmander wearing Friede’s goggles will make its Pokémon GO debut during the event. It can be found in the wild, through Field Research, when using regular Lure Modules and through the event GO Pass. Players can evolve it into Charmeleon and then Charizard while retaining the goggles. Shiny versions will be available, and some encounters may feature a Special Background.

Pikachu wearing Cap’s hat will also return as a possible wild encounter and appear in one-star raids. Three-star raids will feature Charizard wearing Friede’s goggles, Meowscarada, Skeledirge and Quaquaval. Shiny encounters and Special Backgrounds will be available for the featured raid Pokémon.

The wild Pokémon lineup will vary by time of day. From 5:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., players can encounter Pokémon including Fidough and Wattrel, with Chansey appearing more rarely. From 5:00 p.m. to 5:00 a.m., Eevee and Hatenna will be among the featured Pokémon, with Rockruff as a rarer encounter.

Other bonuses include an increased chance of encountering Kecleon at PokéStops, event-themed Field Research and daily PokéStop Showcases. GO Snapshot will also feature surprise appearances from characters and Pokémon seen in Pokémon Horizons .

A limited-time GO Pass will be distributed automatically to players when the event begins, bringing bonuses including double Candy for catching Pokémon, one-hour regular Lure Modules and additional Stardust for catching Hatenna and Wattrel.

The anime broadcast itself will include another in-game bonus. During the September 18 episode, a promotional code will be announced that guarantees an encounter with Charmander wearing Friede’s goggles featuring a Special Background.

The Pokémon TV anime currently follows Liko and Roy’s ongoing adventures, while Pokémon GO originally launched in 2016 as a location-based mobile game. Pokémon revealed its Generation 10 games and starters during this year’s Pokémon Day, presented during the Pokémon Presents livestream on February 27, 2026. The games are titled Pokémon Winds and Pokémon Waves and will release exclusively for the Nintendo Switch 2 in 2027.

The franchise previously revealed numerous special anime shorts, including an anime for World Earth Day , a Dragonite-focused short by CoMix Wave Films on Pokémon Day in 2025, and the recent POKÉTOON short anime titled Wartortle and the Continuation of Summer directed by Shingo Yamashita.

Another new anime, The Misadventures of Sirfetch’d & Pichu , was also recently announced for 2027, as well as a new anime film, Pokémon: Wild Card . The film is being animated by studio CloverWorks and will premiere in 2027.

title: 'Kanata kara' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, Theme Songs, Main Promo
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Kyouko Hikawa 's Kanata kara ( From Far Away ) manga revealed additional cast, staff, theme songs, a key visual (pictured), and the main promotional video on Wednesday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on October 5 at 12.00 a.m. on Tokyo MX, followed by AT-X, ABC TV, and WOWOW.

Cast Gaya Il Biska: Kimiko Saitou ( Eris no Seihai ) Gorya: Tadashi Miyazawa ( Madougushi Dahliya wa Utsumukanai ) Agol Dena Ofa: Taisuke Nakano ( Mayonaka Heart Tune ) Geena Haas: Miku Itou ( Mizu Zokusei no Mahoutsukai )

Staff Art Director: Masaki Mayuzumi ( Boku no Kokoro no Yabai Yatsu ) Color Design: Imari Katsuragi ( Shibou Yuugi de Meshi wo Kuu. ) Director of Photography: In-ju Lee ( Tefuda ga Oome no Victoria [/url]) Editing: Akane Shiraishi ( Gimai Seikatsu ) Sound Director: Satoshi Yano ( Aishiteru Game wo Owarasetai ) Sound Effects: Hidemitsu Tanaka ( Monogatari Series: Off & Monster Season ) Sound Production: Ai Addiction ( Ikoku Nikki )

Japanese boy band Genin wa Jibun ni Aru. ( Tetsunabe no Jan! ) is performing the opening theme "Touhikou," while Nanashi no Taro ([i]Kamierabi 2nd Season) is performing the ending theme "Hikari no Gawa de." Both theme songs are previewed in the main promotional video below.

Noriyuki Abe ( Bleach ) is directing the anime at Studio Deen . Rika Nakase ( Raise wa Tanin ga Ii ) is handling the series composition. Eiji Abiko ( Replica datte, Koi wo Suru. ) is designing the characters, with Takeshi Hama (Cosmic Wave) ( Champignon no Majo ) in charge of music.

Hikawa serialized the fantasy romance manga in LaLa magazine from September 1991 to January 2003. Hakusensha published the 14th and final volume in April 2003.

VIZ Media licensed the manga in English in 2004. The 14th and final volume went on sale in January 2007.

Kanata kara won the 35th Seiun Award in the Comics category in 2004.

Main PV

title: Katekyo Hitman Reborn! Releases Creditless First Anime Opening Featuring "Drawing days" by SPLAY
content:
Katekyo Hitman REBORN! anime has officially released the creditless version of its very first opening, featuring SPLAY’s “Drawing days,” as part of the series’ ongoing 20th anniversary celebrations.

The opening was used for Episodes 1-26 of the TV anime. “Drawing days” was written and composed by Takaaki Mukai, with SPLAY credited for the arrangement and performance.

The release follows yesterday’s announcement of “REBORN! MUSIC MONTH,” a September-long music project celebrating the anime’s 20th anniversary. As previously reported, the campaign will have creditless versions of the series’ past theme song sequences released daily on the official YouTube channel.

These creditless sequences were previously included with physical releases of the anime but had not been officially made available online. You can watch the first one below.

The campaign began on September 1 with an official 25-song playlist featuring opening themes, ending themes and other music from the TV anime.

The manga by Akira Amano ran in Weekly Shonen Jump from May 2004 to November 2012, ending with a total of 42 compilation volumes. The series also received an anime adaptation, which ran for 203 episodes from October 7, 2006 to September 25, 2010. Studio Artland handled the production. The anime is available on Crunchyroll , who describe the story: Tsuna, a timid junior high student, is a failure at school, sports, and social life. But everything around Tsuna has been completely changed when a baby called Reborn, who claims to be an Italian hit man from Vongola family shows up! Reborn was sent to groom Tsuna for his future life as a mafia boss of the family!

title: A Mysterious Figure Appears in Mushoku Tensei Season 3 Episode 11 Preview
content:
Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 revealed the Episode 11 preview images and synopsis ahead of its September 6 premiere. The episode previously revealed its title to be “Turning Point 4,” with fans already ready for it to be another major moment in Rudy’s life. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime as part of its Summer 2026 lineup .

You can see the preview images and synopsis for Episode 11 below.

Having shaken off Atofe’s pursuit, Rudeus and the others manage to obtain Sokas Grass, which is said to be effective against “Dryne Disease.” But will it really cure Nanahoshi’s illness…!? Then, on the night Rudeus finally returns home after a long absence, Man-God (Hitogami) appears and offers him some advice. Just as Rudeus is about to follow it, a mysterious figure suddenly appears…

The main staff for the anime was previously announced and includes:

• Director: Ryosuke Shibuya

• Character Design: Sanae Shimada, Ryota Furukawa

• Music: Yoshiaki Fujisawa

• Studio: Studio Bind

You can also check out the teaser trailer for the ongoing arc below.

Season 3 began with Volume 14, for which Seven Seas describes the story: Nanahoshi, Rudeus, and the rest of their group take a trip to Perugius’s mysterious floating fortress, seeking adventure and a once-in-a-lifetime chance to learn new magic. What they find instead is disaster as one of their number is struck down by a deadly illness. How far will Rudeus go to save a dear friend’s life?

You can also see the key visual for the third season.

The anime is based on a light novel by Rifujin na Magonote with Shirotaka’s illustrations. Seven Seas is publishing the light novel in English. The series is also launching a game titled Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation – Chronicle of Echoes this year. It is a free-to-play game with in-app purchases developed by ASOBIMO.

title: From Far Away TV Anime's New Video Reveals More Cast & Staff, Theme Songs
content:
The official website for the television anime of Kyouko Hikawa 's From Far Away ( Kanata Kara ) shōjo manga presented the anime's main promotional video, key visual, and additional cast and staff members on Wednesday. The video announces and previews the opening theme song "Tōkōkō" by boy group Genin wa Jibun ni Aru. (GNJB), and the ending theme song "Hikari no Gawa de" (At the Side of Light) by four-piece band Nanashi no Tarō .

The newly announced cast members are (Note: Some character names are spelled differently from the manga's English publication by Viz Media ):

• Kimiko Saitō as Gaya

• Tadashi Miyazawa as Gorya

• Taisuke Nakano as Agol

• Miku Itō as Gina Haas

Additional new staff members are:

• Art Director: Masaki Mayuzumi

• Color Key Artist: Imari Katsuragi

• Compositing Director of Photography: Inju Lee

• Editing: Akane Shiraishi

• Sound Director: Satoshi Yano

• Sound Effects: Hidemi Tanaka

• Sound Production: Ai Addiction

Viz Media publishes the manga in English and describes the story:

On her way home from school one day, Noriko is unexpectedly plunged into a strange and extraordinary fantasy world. Her troubles compound exponentially when she is rescued and befriended by a handsome young man by the name of Izark. He may be brave and courageous, but inside Izark lurks the darkest evil imaginable. And according to an ancient prophecy, Noriko possesses the power to unleash that evil. Now, inexorably bound together, these two unlikely allies must navigate a world both wondrous and hostile.

The anime will star (Note: Some character names are spelled differently from the manga's English publication by Viz Media ):

• Tomoyo Kurosawa as Noriko Tachiki

• Kentarō Kumagai as Isaac Kia Taj

• Yūichirō Umehara as Rachev

• Eiji Takeuchi as Kaemos Lee Goda

Noriyuki Abe ( Bleach , Flame of Recca , GTO: Great Teacher Onizuka ) is directing the anime at Studio DEEN . Rika Takasugi ( Ōoku: The Inner Chambers , Yakuza Fiancé: Raise wa Tanin ga Ii ) is in charge of series scripts, Eiji Abiko ( Mr. Osomatsu seasons 3 & 4, Even a Replica Can Fall in Love ) is designing the characters, and Takeshi Hama ( Champignon Witch , Idol Time PriPara ) is composing the music.

The anime will premiere on the Tokyo MX channel on October 4 at 24:00 JST (effectively October 5 at 12 midnight JST), then on October 10 on ABC TV, and on October 13 on WOWOW .

The manga ran in Hakusensha 's LaLa magazine from 1991 to 2002. Hakusensha published the manga's 14th and final compiled book volume in 2003. Hakusensha released the manga's Bunko edition in seven volumes from 2004-2005.

Her troubles compound exponentially when she is rescued and befriended by a handsome young man by the name of Izark. He may be brave and courageous, but inside Izark lurks the darkest evil imaginable. And according to an ancient prophecy, Noriko possesses the power to unleash that evil. Now, inexorably bound together, these two unlikely allies must navigate a world both wondrous and hostile.
The anime will star (Note: Some character names are spelled differently from the manga's English publication by Viz Media ):
Tomoyo Kurosawa as Noriko Tachiki
Kentarō Kumagai as Isaac Kia Taj
Yūichirō Umehara as Rachev
Eiji Takeuchi as Kaemos Lee Goda

Noriyuki Abe ( Bleach , Flame of Recca , GTO: Great Teacher Onizuka ) is directing the anime at Studio DEEN . Rika Takasugi ( Ōoku: The Inner Chambers , Yakuza Fiancé: Raise wa Tanin ga Ii ) is in charge of series scripts, Eiji Abiko ( Mr. Osomatsu seasons 3 & 4, Even a Replica Can Fall in Love ) is designing the characters, and Takeshi Hama ( Champignon Witch , Idol Time PriPara ) is composing the music.
The anime will premiere on the Tokyo MX channel on October 4 at 24:00 JST (effectively October 5 at 12 midnight JST), then on October 10 on ABC TV, and on October 13 on WOWOW .

The manga ran in Hakusensha 's LaLa magazine from 1991 to 2002. Hakusensha published the manga's 14th and final compiled book volume in 2003. Hakusensha released the manga's Bunko edition in seven volumes from 2004-2005.

title: Saint Seiya Creator Masami Kurumada Sues Former Manager, Others for 2.8 Billion Yen
content:
Manga creator Masami Kurumada ( Saint Seiya , B'tX , Ring ni Kakero ) announced in a press conference in Tokyo on Wednesday that he has filed a lawsuit against a former board director and others from three of his companies for allegedly misappropriating funds without authorization. He is seeking an estimated 2.8 billion yen (about US$18 million) in damages.

The three companies include Kurumada Productions, which manages the copyrights and merchandising rights of Kurumada's works. According to Kurumada's legal representatives, the former director was also his former manager who was in charge of accounting, and also took part in establishing Kurumada Production. The former manager has known the manga creator for over 15 years.

According to the lawsuit, the defendants at the three companies allegedly misappropriated funds between around 2018 and 2024 by unauthorized transfer of company funds to other accounts, and by having license fee payments transferred to accounts under different company names.

The total misappropriated funds is estimated at 4.6 billion yen (about US$29 million), and Kurumada's legal representatives are seeking 2.8 billion yen in compensation, excluding the 1.8 billion yen (about US$11 million) that has already been repaid.

Kurumada had announced in January 2024 that he would launch the first major exhibition of his manga art in June 2024, but his website announced in March 2024 the cancellation of the exhibition "due to various circumstances."

Kurumada published the original Saint Seiya manga from 1986 to 1990. The manga has inspired a number of television anime, original video anime projects, anime films, and spinoff manga. The original series has 35 million copies in print.

Saint Seiya: Next Dimension - The Myth of Hades (image right) launched in 2006 and ended in July 2024.

Viz Media published the original manga in English under the title Saint Seiya: Knights of the Zodiac . ADV Films released Toei Animation 's anime adaptation with an English dub under the title Knights of the Zodiac , and later released it unedited under the title Saint Seiya . New Video Group later also released the series on DVD.

Knights of the Zodiac: Saint Seiya , the CG anime remake based on the original manga, debuted worldwide in July 2019. Saint Seiya: Knights of the Zodiac - Battle for Sanctuary - , the second season , debuted in July 2021. Saint Seiya: Knights of the Zodiac - Battle for Sanctuary - Part 2 , the next part , premiered in April 2024.

A live-action film of the manga titled Knights of the Zodiac opened in 2023.

Kurumada recently launched the new series Saint Seiya Tenkai-hen ( Saint Seiya : The Heavens Arc) in Akita Shoten 's Weekly Shōnen Champion magazine on May 14.

title: The World's Strongest Rearguard Anime Director Yuji Yanase Dies at 59
content:
Anime director Yuji Yanase, who directed the currently airing The World’s Strongest Rearguard: Labyrinth Country’s Novice Seeker , died on August 22, 2026. He was 59 years old.

The anime’s production committee announced Yanase’s passing on September 2, expressing its condolences and reflecting on his contributions to the series.

“We are deeply saddened by the sudden news of his passing. Director Yanase devoted tremendous effort to the production of The World’s Strongest Rearguard: Labyrinth Country’s Novice Seeker, leading the production team with his passion and warm personality. We would like to express our heartfelt gratitude and offer our deepest condolences.”

MAHO FILM, where Yanase was employed, separately announced that the director died of a myocardial infarction on August 22. According to the studio, his funeral was held privately with close relatives in accordance with his family’s wishes. MAHO FILM also thanked fans and others who supported Yanase during his lifetime.

Yanase had worked as an anime director on numerous productions. His directing credits include By the Grace of the Gods , In the Land of Leadale , If It’s for My Daughter, I’d Even Defeat a Demon Lord , and In Another World with My Smartphone , among other titles.

His latest project, The World’s Strongest Rearguard: Labyrinth Country’s Novice Seeker , is currently ongoing. The fantasy series follows Arihito, who is reincarnated in the Labyrinth Country and takes on the support-focused “Rearguard” class, capable of assisting his party through attack, defense and recovery abilities.

The production committee has not announced any changes to the anime’s broadcast or production schedule in its statement.

title: Main Staff for 'Ikyou no Tsume Nuri Minarai' Announced
content:
Publishing company Shufu to Seikatsusha announced the main staff for the anime adaptation of Murakawa 's Ikyou no Tsume Nuri Minarai ( Apprentice Nail Artist in a Foreign Land ) manga on Wednesday.

Staff Director: Daiji Iwanaga ( Ponkotsu Fuuki Iin to Skirt-take ga Futekisetsu na JK no Hanashi ) Series Composition: Tomoko Konparu ( Kimi ni Todoke ) Script: Tomoko Konparu, Michiko Yokote ( Naruto ) Studio: Zero-G

Marukawa began drawing the isekai fantasy manga in Comic PASH! in March 2022. Shufu to Seikatsusha published the sixth volume in October 2025, with the seventh volume scheduled for a September 4 release.

Tokyopop licensed the manga in English and released the first volume in April 2026. The second volume is scheduled for release on September 8.
